fullContentHtml:
UPSSSC Auditor/ Assistant Accountant Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of Auditor/ Assistant Accountant on its official website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 1829 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Auditor/ Assistant Accountant Recruitment 2026 will start from 14 July 2026, and candidates can apply until 03 August 2026. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for UPSSSC Auditor/ Assistant Accountant Recruitment 2026 given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 July 2026
  • Last Date : 03 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 August 2026
  • Correction Last Date : Notify Later
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
